title: Extreme heat downs several performers during Iligan’s Diyandi Festival

blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — Several performers collapsed due to extreme heat during the Diyandi Festival here on Sunday, held in celebration of the city’s patronal fiesta in honor of Saint Michael the Archangel.
